note: SC-9/A1(c) pin. A path containing `..` cannot be bounded by a prefix policy at all -- that is a FACT about the input, so it fails (SC-8 house rule). Reverting isSafeRelativePath alone flips this fixture: without it the path is merely `outside_allowed_paths`, which is a different and weaker finding, and an absolute path would not be caught at all.
